## Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to the page / flow where the issue occurs
2. Perform the action
3. See the issue

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened.

## Device & Firmware Info
- **Firmware version:** [e.g. 0.1.6]
- **Hardware:** ESP32-2432S028 (CYD)
- **Display orientation:** Portrait / Landscape
- **Screen timeout:** e.g. 5 min / Never
- **Theme:** Light / Dark

## Network Info
- **Wi-Fi connected?** Yes / No
- **SpoolmanSync server IP and port:** `<host>:<port>` *(do not post your password)*
- **Can you reach the server from a browser?** Yes / No

## Logs / Output
Paste any relevant serial monitor logs (115200 baud), error messages, or screenshots.
Please remove private info (Wi-Fi password, printer serials, internal IPs you don't want public).

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or details about the problem here.
